notes.title: French Indie Sale - Up To 80% Off Popular French Indie Games
notes.notes:
Celebrate top French independent game developers with the French Indie Sale, running today on Steam!

Organized by Seaven Studio together with over dozen other French indie developers, the promotion features 15 innovative French indie games. Pick from hits like Evoland, Fly’N, Strike Vector and gems like Tetrobot and Co., Type:Rider, Ethan: Meteor Hunter and many more!

All of these titles are discounted on Steam starting Sept 17 at 10 am Pacific Time for 48h only until Sept 19 at 10am Pacific time.

For more details, and the full list of titles on sale, please see http://store.steampowered.com/sale/frenchindiesale

notes.title: Mechanic Escape is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Be prepared to die.. a lot !
 
Each world presents a different aesthetic and atmosphere in addition to ramping up the difficulty.
Your patience and your platforming skills will be tested to their highest levels.
 
Select one of the four characters, brave the dangers and go find your comrades in order to rescue your species!
 
 
We hope you will enjoy the game :) 
Last but not the least play the TV do not watch it!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Mechanic Escape
notes.notes:
Mechanic Escape is Now Available on Steam!
In a world oppressed by ruthless machines, a stronghold full of die-hard TV-sets resists the persecution. Your lost friends and the lack of resources drive you to take action against the extinction. Brave the dangers and go find your comrades to rescue your species!

notes.title: Mechanic Escape will be available starting with tomorrow!
notes.notes:
That will be for you the occasion to discover and share the Steam trading cards of the game. 
And afterwards why not put a beautiful Mechanic Escape background on your gamer profile?! 

Therefore, prepare your controllers and play the TVs!

notes.title: The hardcore platformer
notes.notes:
If you are playing just for relaxing, you may better not waste your time. 
Mechanic Escape is a die and retry game for hardcore gamers that want to challenge their skills.
In order to achieve certain levels, you may have to go beyond the “rage quit”.

Different characters
Before starting a level it will be possible to pick the hero of your choice, among four characters! But about that I will tell you later! Just stay tuned!

notes.title: We are approaching the world premiere launch!
notes.notes:
It is about the moment to give you new information about the Mechanic Escape adventure:
Mechanic Escape it is a challenging game for hardcore gamers that want to test their skills. 

Time Attack
In addition to collecting small TV sets, a time attack mode was set up in order to challenge your friends and see who is the fastest. 

Death Counter
We thought that it would be amusing to add up a counter of your death number on each level. Therefore, each player could know how many times he/she died.
On the main menu, a counter sums up the total number of deaths since you first launched the game. 

Stay tuned for April 15th.
